claims.claim: IANA tzdb 2026e was released 2026-09-29 and time-zone rules can change due to political decisions.
claims.implementation_note: The UI warns that runtime browser data may lag upstream.

claims.claim: Intl.DateTimeFormat time-zone behavior is supplied by the ECMAScript internationalization implementation.
claims.implementation_note: No server-side time-zone API is called.

uncertainty: Political time-zone changes can be announced with little notice. A stale browser can therefore disagree with the latest IANA tzdb. Historical pre-1970 fidelity also varies by platform.
